title: Rabbi Shimon bar Ami
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: A precious saying of his has remained with us in [Bereshit Rabbah 22:6](https://www.sefaria.org/Bereshit_Rabbah.22.6): Rabbi Berekhiah said in his name, 'Happy is the person who is higher than his transgressions.' And there, [26:4 of the linked edition (Hyman cites 24:4)](https://www.sefaria.org/Bereshit_Rabbah.26.4): 'Rabbi Shimon bar Ami — his wife bore him a female.' Hyman calls this a scribal error, citing [Bava Batra 16b](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Batra.16b.9), where the story concerns Rabbi Shimon son of Rabbi.[^1]

notes.text: The maxim and the childbirth episode are separate. The Hebrew of the linked Midrash names Rabbi Shimon bar Ami. Its English follows the reading favored by Hyman, Rabbi Shimon son of Rabbi, which also appears in the linked Bavli. Rabbi Chiyya the Elder reassures Shimon in the Midrash, while Shimon’s father consoles him in the Bavli.
